Councillor of Llandough,

Have you seen this footage?  https://youtu.be/4GXmR7mAas0?feature=shared

I'm a military cyber warfare professional.
Not much gets past me.
I was the best hacker in our Government and military in 2005.
In fact I already note this footage was cut and censored to hide key facts.
Not to mention this and other press coverage and footage supressed. Even
unto this day.

More interestingly than my mum's appearance at the end of the clip, is the
news anchor who was my old best friends mum. That same best friend is now
an executive of press monitoring company Meltwater Media in Cardiff City.

land & home. And it's all going into a Netflix documentry along with the
handling of this matter which you still all try to bury and cover up. Like
the hundreds of child graves surrounding this case. You are all committing
career and political suicide.

I'm still waiting for you and the MP to respond to this matter.  For months
now.
MoJ won't comment as they say its ongoing. See attached. Which doesn't make
sense as I've not begun legal proceedings and this hasn't been touched in
decades.
They also took half a year just to reply.

Land Registry made my query into a complaint and shut it down instantly.
Cadw falsely allege they have nothing to do with it when they were pivotal
in it. They should have listen it as a grade II.

I'm not rolling up with tanks, but I'm not going away. We need to
straighten this all out.

You know the clause with harassment? I.e. If I have reason to pursue I may
persist. And so I will persist. But I have no desire to make you feel
harassed. So please just all do your jobs. And diligently.

My family are still all terrorised into silence about this, even decades
later. It's a hostage/ terrorist situation in my estimation (As a military
warfare professional).

I find dealing with my former community and Govenrment 50/50 at the moment.
Which is good enough odds for me to refrain from any direct action on this
matter. For now.

I'm actually still giving you and the MP the benefit of the doubt you're
busy and/or mulling this over still, before taking a position on the
matter. But justice delayed is justice denied. Like the MoJ taking half a
year to reply only to fob me off. Tick tick.

It's not just my family being held hostage there, but my people seem
demoralised and its no way for them to all live. I already fly in and out
like its another military tour of Iraq. I was shot at in Barry and an
Afghan tried stealing my dog last time I was back.

I will feel my villages warmth one way or another. When it's our ancestral
home for centuries. How dare we be ignored, disregarded and exiled. Or shot
at and shunned. Next time I fly home I want it to feel like home. Not
another tour of the middle east where I had to get behind a GPMG in SF role
from a helicopter.

The situation is untenable. We can't go on like this another decade, with
you Brit'ish all on our stolen land without a care in the world, and us all
dispossessed, butchered and forced out by force, secrecy and fraudulent
license.

You don't seem to fathom the ongoing harm, injury and loss here. This
dispossession and disposition, tantamount to a terrorist/ hostage situation
has been ongoing almost 4 decades. My families silence from being
terorrised into silence and the years its taken for me to discover the
fraud, due to the stealth, secretly and complexity of it, does not put this
in the past but very much in our faces today.

Our family demand of you and anyone other installed persons, proclaiming
legitimate authority of our lands, immediately address this matter. I'm not
the kind to hold a gun to your head and demand attention. I'm being polite,
courteous and professional here. And patient and understanding. But it
would not be sane or reasonable for me to allow you or the MP to cause me
let or hiderence.

In my experience if you won't tackle this in the open I have to presume you
are going  clandestine and into the shadows and thus pose risk of further
threat to me and my family. As the British State.

There's gaps in records. Court mistakes. There's supressed, redacted,
censored media coverage. Procedural unfairness. Fraud. Theft. And the
silence and lack of co operation rectifying records and narratives only
diminishes your legitimacy and so your authority.

You wouldn't need to be clandestine and abuse force to try to handle men
like me and mine, if you'd just all straighten out this matter. Then you'd
have my trust and fieldty.

You know at the WCIT in Dubai with the help of David Cameron in 2012, it
took a few weeks to exit UK from the treaty. Which is something I had to
bring up with my bank the other day who took twice as long to process a
refund after a dispute because of all the beurocracy. Similarly with this
we have no barriers to communicate, we have A.I, we have digital systems
and digital records yet this is being made into a slow, tedious, confusing,
cumbersom, challenging, obstructive process.

Don't weaponise time. Justice delayed is justice denied. I am accustom to
time being abused so that other hybrid warfare war crime avenues can be
explored like trying to kidnap and silence me. I know the British State
acts like a terrorist organisation even by its own definition of one,
because I was one of you terorrists. In an illegal war. On another
indigenous population. I also spent most of my adult life in exile in latin
american now so I can draw all the parallels between the regime on British
Isles and cartel/ crime syndicates on other banana republics. Ours stink
and is no different to other islands. So let's not fancy our regime or
actors in it, as any better or more benevolant or honest than others.

My postion, proportionate to the situation, seems correct. In that a multi
generational civil war has been waged on my family, home and people, as
indigenous Welsh Britons, on our ancestral birthland. And having completed
my 22 years in oath in 2024, under the employ of the Vale council, I no
longer have the restraint of allegiance to the Brit'ish State. I am
naturally leaning towards being a counter officer and pro Wales fully
decolonising. Bearing in mind this war being waged isn't us ontowards the
Brit'ish State, but the exact opposite. And there's no requirement on our
part we participate willingly or make it any easier than is neccesary to
soft genocide us. After already dispossesing, displacing, looting,
butchering and holding us hostage or exiling us.

In any case I believe my families standing, title and estate was stolen.
Via fraud and armed force. Once the cover up and falsified records are
rectified it will be more apparent why restoration and reperations should
occur. Because it's already very clear to me. As a cyber and electronic
military warfare professional and certified and experienced military
commander and leader. As well as me being the son and grandson of the man
and his mum butchered in the process of this fraud and cover up attempt of
the crimes relating to this terrorist siege on our land and property of
centuries.

We Britons do not negotiate with terrorists.
I'm not SAS. I'm who JSHQ Northwood sent to break the SAS out of the Iraq
prison days before they got executed. I setup the covert drone surveillance
via satellies between Iraq and London. Now it's the inverse situation where
you're regime is on my lands, have executed my family members, hold my
family hostage and still act like terrorists. Silence does not work in your
favour with me. I just presume you are otherwise engaging in clandestine
warfare with me.

I'm hoping for the best. I really am.
Peace, due process, dialouge etc.

This isn't even our generations fight. It's an inherited scandal and mess,
passed down to us. The responsibility to rectify this matter is a fudiciary
one. And I'm just the one in my family daring to simply speak about this.
No wonder none of the hostages there speak. It just becomes another
opportunity for you to all reaffirm our people are hostages under
terrorists.


I've seen recently others speaking out and speaking up being separated from
their evidence, charges fabricated and them subjected to interment. I
myself already had to have the support of a US Marine officer when attempts
were made to frame and extradite and silence me. The defence correspondent
for the mail on Sunday was also contracted to destroy my reputation in a
nationwide campaign before. Which I also managed to stop in time. So I know
the lengths that the regime on that island will go to, to cover up crimes
and fraud instead of remedy.

 I doubt a lot of you are even human at this point. Not because of my
actual military attachment to the underground UFO city in Coresham. But
because a mars attack type alien invasion and occupancy and rule is exactly
the vibes I get when I'm back on my motherland. Citizenship seems to now
mean to be hostages whereby people are gagged, hands tied behind their
backs and on their knees. That is the exact situation I see people in, on
British Isles. Any moment due to have our throats slit.

Not for me thank you. I much preferred being behind the machine gun in a
helicopter pointing it at the inhumane terrorists treating humans this way.

I spoke to my sister earlier about an article stating that bailiffs stole,
against the explicit injunction instructions, £30,000 of my dads after
evictim him from his home. In 1988. She told me my family there haven't
ever experienced having £30,000 laying around the house in the almost 40
years since. If that doesn't tell me they're like Jews of nazi Germany
under the occupancy and rule of the tyranny and terrorism there i don't
know what does.

So it is a hostage / terorrist situation so far as I see. We're not
forgotten about. I've made it very clear for months and I'm just ignored
and rebuttled and dismissed. So  clearly someone believes we're not all
equal under God. Or law. That's disappointing.

Regards,

Sion Buckler Esq (Ret'd Sgt)
Rightful Executor of Manor of Llandough

Sir/Madam,
I am writing on behalf of myself and siblings who are the heirs and
successors of Mary Williams of the Williams family, rightful owners and
occupiers of Great House Farm, Llandough since 1667 until our dispossession
via armed force in 1988.
I write to summarize our position regarding our historical and ongoing
dispossession of Great House Farm, which I alledge involves;
- Denial of right to be heard by the land registry due to the fact my
grandmother Mr Williams (falsy named Mrs Buckler to diminish the Williams
ancestral superior land claim) conveniently died and our family were in
mourning in the limited window granted to challenge BP registration of our
land and property in their names. Much like my grandfather conveniently
died too, before  being able to clarify, even to my grandmother Mrs
Williams, how her Title ended up in BP's possession. Because until her
dying breath she maintained her ownership claim. Despite repeated unlawful
attempts over decades to disposition the firm position she maintained about
hers and ours undisputed ancestral and superior land claim to the land in
question.
After my father's appeal of the BP vs Buckler 1987 ruling was dismissed on
grounds of "heads BP win, tails we lose" and his home demolished, all money
and possessions removed (despite a court injuction ordering nothing be
removed) and despite his ECHR request being blocked, and arrest without
charge, and hospitalisation and then his convenient death at age 41, our
remaining family of mostly women and children, have to this day been too
terrified to speak up. According to recently released, supressed ITV news
coverage from 1988, bailifs occupying our stolen land and property, even
dislocated my mum's shoulder for simply serving them a lawful court
injunction.
And without the discovery of fraud this year, (which has taken me two
decades and a career in military cyber and electronic warfare and the
recent innovations in A.I to discover) we had no redress recourse due to
the statute of limitation and time passed, ever had we not all been too
traumatised like hostages under terrorists to speak out. This whole thing,
even unto this day is scandalous treatment of me and my family. Not
withstanding I am a war veteran, who left my military career with honours
and was employed until 2024 under the Vale of Glamorgan Council/ Welsh
Govenrment. Finished my 22 years in Oath BONAFIDE.
ITV coverage supressed until recent months also says neighbours report it
was like an SAS Style Operation to remove us by force in 1988. And the men
in the video do look SAS. I have subbmitee a FOI to the MOD.
And Margaret Thatchers administration at the time (you Brit'ish) were
evidently helping BP claw assets for the UK Governments exit at the time.
Which might explain how 30 police and maybe SAS were used to rip us from
our home and land.
Land registry ultimately had check balances lifted and total free reign,
while BPs lawyers commited purgergy in their declarations to them;
withholding information from and supplying to the land registry false
information.
All the while Welsh TV simultaneously interviewed Ghadaffi in Lybia in
1988, who report him accusing Thatcher and the Brit'ish State of being the
real terrorists, not him. My oath ended in 2024, I'm also a Welsh National.
I have no allegiance to the British State. If it acts like my enemy, its my
enemy.
Other media coverage alleged by UK courts to exist from 1974 seems non
existence or suppressed too.
Fraud and proceedural unfairness are ultimately rampant in the case of my
families dispossession. Aside from all my family members dying at all the
convenient junctures instrumental to change the outcome of our
dispossession, I still have major concerns with how the MOJ just took
months to respond only to fob me off last week. Or how the MP fobbed me off
and will not provide a proper response. Or how CADW alledge this is nothing
to do with them despite failing to list the farm house as a grade II so it
couldn't be demolished. As per a 1700 signature petition, which was
practically the whole town at the time. Or the current councillor for
Llandough failing to properly reply. Or the fact the national archives
report gaps and missing and supressed records. Not withstanding Marconi was
staying with us while inventing radio and the town won't even out a plaque
up to make that known. Which is more erasure of the history. Like in BPs
planning application saying our 800 year old former court house home was
just an old delapitated building.
Not withstanding the supression of the 1870 roman soldier we discovered
when changing our floor from stone to timber. Also supressed to hide the
sites archaeological significants so housing development could be
unlawfully approved. And BP didn't even seek a ruling on ownership, they
only saught possession, most likely so that the discovery and significant
of the sites archaeological significants could be pretended to not be known
until the excavation of our land in 1994. Which is just more evidence of
the blatant conspiracy and fraud.
This is all the actions of a crime or terrorist network. To install a
terrorist cell/ camp. It's worse than just the Brit'ish colonising Wales.
Not withstanding the child graves secretly moved from the church next door
during the exhivation seem to take 10 years to be properly reported on and
even then their numbers in the report seem to be under represented.
The scandal just goes on and on. It's the gift that keeps giving. There's
court mistakes too. The fancy latin words deminish and falsely describe my
nans land claim and superior ownership. And language used clearly shows a
bias before a ruling. Language used to imply she is almost imagining her
ancestral superior land claim to discredit her in the carefully selected
wording used by the judge. In court records that use the false legal
fiction name fabricated by BP in their license letters document fraud,
instead of her actual name. Evidently to shy away from the Williams name
and its superior inpenitrable and unbreakable land claim. For which we
remain the heirs and successors.
1667 we aquired the land and property in a 999 year leasehold. And in the
early 1900's obtained the superior paper title, free and clear outright
equitable ownership, via the deal with Bute Estates quarryman Daniel
Thomas. Which led to the tree planting ceremony to affirm this in history.
Fredrick Bucklers transfer of Mrs Williams title to BP and their
predecessors without her knowledge or consent isn't legitimate and so has
no authority. Him not being able to clarify that transaction due to dying
doesn't make it right as Mary Williams maintained her position after his
death. She just couldn't prove what she claimed without title. And the
adjournment and dismissal of the two hearings in 1974 where she made her
case, but without getting the ruling doesn't negate the facts.
This was a coordinated campaign of fraud, stealth, and administrative
erasure. Over decades.
Summary of the Fraudulent Dispossession:

   - The Title Theft: Evidence supports that a "Title-for-Quarrying"
   agreement existed with Daniel Thomas of the Bute Estate. We maintain
   this title was later secretly and fraudulently sold back to the landlords
   by Frederick Buckler without the knowledge or consent of the rightful
   owner, Mary Williams.
   - Procedural Fraud (The 1974 License): The 1987 Court of Appeal ruling
   was predicated on a unilateral "license letter" issued by the landlords’
   solicitors. We reject this document as a fraudulent instrument of stealth
   designed to bypass adverse possession rights without Mary Williams’
   agreement.
   - Identity Erasure: Throughout all legal proceedings, Mary Williams was
   intentionally misidentified as "Mrs. Buckler." This was a calculated tactic
   to strip her of her ancestral "Williams" lineage and the superior land
   rights associated with it.
   - Exploitation of Mortality:
      - Frederick Buckler: Died before the truth of the title sale could be
      brought to light.
      - Mary Williams: Died during the precise 2-week window required to
      rebut the Land Registry’s registration of the land in BP’s
name—a window we
      believe was exploited to finalize a theft.
      - William Buckler: His untimely death following the unfair dismissal
      of his appeal effectively blocked our path to the ECHR.

Our Position:
The Williams family has never ceased its claim. We maintain that the land
was taken through criminal stealth and that the current registered titles
are "poisoned" by this original fraud. We are now seeking full reparations
for the loss of ancestral wealth, the destruction of the Roman
archaeological site on the property, and the systematic denial of our right
to a fair trial.
Please provide a formal response and update regarding your position on this
matter within 14 days.
Regards,
Sion Buckler
On behalf of and one of the Heirs and Successors of Mary Williams

This includes examining the possibility of systemic issues like fraud, suppression of evidence, or ignoring/working around agricultural and heritage protections in adverse possession disputes—potentially to unlawfully or unconstitutionally stop limitation clock on adverse possession—while using the Great House Farm (BP v Buckler 1987) as a key example. The focus remains on devolved matters: Welsh historic environment policy, agricultural safeguards, CADW's role, and reforms to address gaps without revisiting specific court judgments.

And yes I have an address, it's [redacted]. I am a constituent in the Vale of Glamorgan and I have written to the current MP and councillor Carroll in Llandough, they are aware and I trust they are looking into it.

If framed this way—emphasizing a possible "class" of affected Welsh farms/families and broader policy failures—do you believe it would meet the standards to gain the Committee's attention and proceed to submission/publication?

Fraud is never too far in the past as the statute of limitation doesn't apply in such circumstances and furthermore it unravels all according to law. It is also only limited from the date it was discovered and I recently discovered, not from the date of occurrence of the alleged fraud.

Notwithstanding we are still an dispossessed indigenous Welsh family on our ancestral birthland. We are still here.

Failing that, what alternative steps do you recommend (e.g., approaching a Member of the Senedd, Welsh Government departments like CADW, or other channels for raising systemic land/agricultural issues)?

Any advice on strengthening wording or evidence would be appreciated before submission.

Thank you—this matter holds significant importance for Welsh cultural, agricultural, and historical integrity.

Regards,

Sion Buckler [redacted]

Subject: BP Properties Ltd v Buckler – Request for Opinion (Limitation Act 1980 s.32)
From: Sion Buckler
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 05:59 UTC
------------------------------------------------------------

Dear Mr Thomas,

I am seeking a preliminary opinion regarding potential grounds to reopen
the case BP Properties Ltd v Buckler (Court of Appeal, 31 July 1987),
concerning Great House Farm, Llandough, Vale of Glamorgan.

There appear to be two material issues:

1. Corporate Party Identification:
Correspondence relevant to the dispute was exchanged with BP Pension Trust
Ltd, while litigation and enforcement proceeded under BP Properties Ltd.
The Court treated these entities as separate when assessing notice but
effectively identical in dismissing the appeal and enforcing possession.
This inconsistency may constitute a mistake or misrepresentation under
Limitation Act 1980, Section 32.


2. Effect of the 1974 Letters:
The Court found that unilateral letters in 1974 granting a licence to
occupy rent-free for life converted possession from adverse to licensed.
However, I understand there is no evidence that this licence was ever
accepted. If acceptance did not occur, adverse possession may have
continued and the running of limitation may not have been interrupted as
the judgment assumes.


I would be grateful for:

Your view on whether these issues may be sufficient to apply to set aside
or reopen enforcement, or otherwise seek remedy or restitution; and

Your guidance on next procedural steps.


I can provide Judgment text and Newspaper records of the demolition (1988)
etc.

Thank you for your consideration.

Yours sincerely,

Sion Hywel Buckler
[phone redacted]
texts.wb-1f61018c:
Sirs/Ma'am,

I'm writing in relation to land formerly known as *Great House Farm,
Llandough (Vale of Glamorgan)*, subsequently developed for residential use
and historically connected with the proceedings culminating in *BP v
Buckler (Court of Appeal, 1987)*.

I appreciate that the Local Planning Authority is not responsible for
determining land ownership, nor am I asking it to do so. My purpose is to
place on record a *chronological summary of unresolved land-governance
issues* which may be material to the integrity of the planning history
relied upon for that site.

In brief and as reflected in public records:

   -

   In *July 1974*, proceedings involving my grandmother and BP both
   asserting ownership, were adjourned and did not result in a judicial final
   determination.
   -

   On *31 October 1974*, a further listed hearing did not proceed
   substantively, following correspondence sent that morning by BP entities.
   No judgment on title was issued. My nan requested the audience with the
   judge the day before, with her lawyer. But that got leaked, the press
   descended on our farm (not that I can find evidence of news articles from
   said press), and the following morning the two letters from BP arrived to
   our solicitor, effectively squashing the court hearing and audience with
   the judge my nan had sought, to make her case of ownership. Her reply to
   both BP letters (one from BP Pension Trust Ltd and one from BP Properties
   Ltd), that morning of the 31st of October, was also 'I own the land'.
   -

   Throughout this period, my grandmother was *excluded from dealings*
   concerning land we asserted we owned, while the opposing party
continued to *assert
   ownership*, notwithstanding the absence of a concluded judicial finding.
   -

   In or around *1982*, the land was registered in BP’s name, despite the
   earlier proceedings never having resolved the competing claims nor having
   resulted in findings adverse to my grandmother.
   -

   My grandmother then died in *1983*, after the registration had taken
   place, without compensation and without any final adjudication of her claim.
   -

   In the *1987 appeal*, the Court referred to correspondence as having
   been replied to (albeit not to the correct corporate entity - which is
   ultimately why we lost BP vs Buckler 1987), yet in my fathers appeal that
   followed, whereby he argued that surely BP Pension Trust should have been
   the claimant not BP Properties, the same judge from the case dismissed the
   appeal citing that both companies were effectively the same. This is all
   evidence on the face of the public record of these proceedings.
   -

   By that stage, and in the absence of a documentary title which had
   effectively been overtaken by registration, my family was driven to advance
   arguments in adverse possession as a *fallback position*, which itself
   should have assured our continued occupancy.

The cumulative effect was that my family was *displaced*, the land was
developed, and no compensation was ever paid, despite ownership never
having been conclusively decided in court. Whether intentionally or not,
the process operated in a manner where asserted ownership became treated as
settled fact.

I am not alleging misconduct, nor am I seeking retrospective remedies from
the Authority. I am simply asking whether, given the above sequence, it
would be appropriate for the Authority to:

   -

   note that historic planning decisions were taken on the basis of *assumed
   title*, and
   -

   record that the underlying ownership dispute was *never finally
   adjudicated*, for the sake of transparency and future governance
   integrity.

This correspondence is intended to be factual, measured, and
non-adversarial. I am happy to supply references to the relevant hearings,
registrations, or judgments if that assists your records. But what I'm
highlighting here is all on public record and in the public eye.


Yours faithfully,


Sion Buckler

a BP Properties Ltd yn “effeithiol yr un cwmni”. Fodd bynnag, yn y
dyfarniad yr oedd yn ei herio, nododd y barnwr nad oedd ymatebion fy nain i
BP Pension Trust Ltd yn cyfrif gan mai BP Properties Ltd oedd yr hawlydd,
ac mai cwmnïau ar wahân oeddent. Yn ymarferol, roedd hyn yn arwain at
sefyllfa “pen y cwmni’n ennill, cynffon y teulu’n colli”.

Yn sgil hyn, cafodd fy nhad ei dynnu o’i wely ysbyty, ei garcharu heb
gyhuddiad, a gosodwyd gorchymyn atal arno i’w atal rhag meddiannu ac
amddiffyn ein fferm 800 oed rhag cael ei dymchwel. Cafodd ei gais i’r Llys
Hawliau Dynol Ewropeaidd ei rwystro cyn iddo farw yn 1991, yn ddim ond 41
oed.

Ar y sail hon, rwy’n gofyn yn ffurfiol am *Ddeiseb i sefydlu Ymchwiliad
Cyhoeddus* i’r achos hwn, fel mater o ddwyn tir hanesyddol ac o dorri
hawliau dynol yng Nghymru.

Rwy’n weithiwr proffesiynol ym maes seiber a rhyfela electronig milwrol.
Mae technolegau AI pwerus bellach ar gael i bob un ohonom, ac nid oes
unrhyw reswm technegol pam na ellid archwilio’r mater hwn yn llawn ac yn
drylwyr. Mae’r hyn a ddigwyddodd i’m teulu yn ymddangos fel anghyfiawnder
dwys, aml-genhedlaethol, ac yn debyg i ffurf ar “lawfare”, lle y trinwyd fy
nheulu fel llafur di-dâl i gynnal ased tir hyd nes yr oedd yn gyfleus i’w
ariannu. Mae’n arwyddocaol bod bron pob cam yn ein herbyn wedi digwydd ar
yr eiliad olaf posibl.

Ceir honiadau bod sylw sylweddol yn y wasg yn 1974 o blaid fy nain a’n
teulu, ynghyd â deiseb o tua 1,700 o bobl yn ceisio atal dymchwel y fferm.
Ymhellach, mae’n ymddangos bod CADW wedi methu ag ymyrryd lle dylai’r safle
fod wedi cael statws Adeilad Rhestredig Gradd II.

Nid wyf yn sicr a gofnodwyd erioed yn briodol yn y Gofrestrfa Tir fod y tir
— a gofrestrwyd gan BP yn 1982 — dan anghydfod. Yn fy nealltwriaeth i,
cafodd ei drin fel pe na bai mewn anghydfod o gwbl. Nid oes unrhyw lys wedi
penderfynu’n derfynol mai BP oedd perchnogion cyfreithiol y tir; cafodd
hynny ei honni yn hytrach na’i brofi.

Mae hefyd fater pwysig o hanes diwylliannol. Arhosodd Marconi gyda’n teulu
yn y fferm wrth iddo ddatblygu radio. Mae cynghorwyr a’r plwyf yn Llandough
yn gwrthod cydnabod hyn. Rwy’n deall bod Marconi yn cael ei ystyried yn
wleidyddol eithafol ar y dde, ac, fel y gwelir yn achos y cerflun radio ym
Mae Caerdydd, mae ei rôl hanesyddol yn cael ei hailysgrifennu. Mae’n
rhesymol tybio bod ein teulu wedi cael ei ddal mewn ymgyrch wleidyddol
ehangach o’r chwith yn erbyn y dde, ac mai am roi llety i Marconi y bu i ni
wynebu canlyniadau canrif o hyd — problemau nad oedd yn bodoli yn y tair
canrif flaenorol yr oeddem wedi byw ar y fferm.

Roedd mam Marconi hefyd yn Jamerson o gwmni wisgi Gwyddelig Jameson. Rwy’n
gofyn i chi gynnal eich ymchwil eich hun, gwneud eich ymholiadau eich hun,
a dod i’ch casgliadau eich hun — ond yn anad dim, peidiwch â chaniatáu i
hanes gael ei ailysgrifennu yma.

Mae fy nheulu bellach yn archwilio opsiynau ar gyfer siarad cyhoeddus,
hawliau stori, a dogfennaeth. Yn nhermau cysylltiadau teuluol: fy nhaid
oedd Ray Smith o Dempsey and Makepeace; mae fy modryb yn Shan Cothi; a
dechreuodd fy ewythr y band Tigertailz.

Rwy’n disgrifio’r sefyllfa hon fel gwarthus. Mae fy nheulu’n mynnu
cyfiawnder am gael ein dadleoli a’n dwyn o’n tir a’n heiddo gan y Sefydliad
Prydeinig a BP, gyda phrin unrhyw amddiffyniad dan y gyfraith. Rydym yn
deulu Cymreig brodorol, Cymraeg eu hiaith, wedi byw yng Nghaerdydd, Bro
Morgannwg, a’r fferm yn Llandough ers cannoedd o flynyddoedd.

O’r hyn y gallaf ei gasglu, ceir dwsinau o achosion posibl o dwyll a
chuddio gwybodaeth, sy’n golygu nad yw statud cyfyngiadau yn berthnasol o
reidrwydd. I’r rhai sy’n cefnogi dad-drefedigaethu Cymru ac annibyniaeth,
prin y ceir enghraifft gliriach na *BP v Buckler (1987)* o’r hyn a
ddigwyddodd i deulu ffermio Cymreig wrth herio’r Wladwriaeth Brydeinig a
chorfforaeth fawr. Nid yw eraill wedi codi’r mater hwn, yn bennaf oherwydd
trawma cenhedlaethol.

Rwyf wedi profi fy hun. Gadewais fy ngyrfa filwrol gydag anrhydedd, gan
gwblhau fy llw 22 mlynedd. Cefais fy nghyflogi’n bona fide gan Gyngor Bro
Morgannwg a Llywodraeth Cymru hyd at 2024. Gwasanaethais mewn rhyfeloedd yn
y Dwyrain Canol. Fodd bynnag, nid yw’r anghyfiawnder fferm yn fater unigol.

Yn 2013, cafodd fy mab 36 diwrnod oed ei gipio, ac nid wyf erioed wedi ei
weld ers hynny. Cafodd tŷ ei ddwyn oddi arnaf (40 Lombard Street, Y Barri).
Yn 2023, cefais fy ngadael i gysgu mewn pabell tra roedd bron i 100 o
Afghanistaniaid yn cael eu lletya’n dawel wrth ymyl ein pentref o 11 tŷ,
tra roedd yn rhaid imi aros yno i ofalu am fy nain gan na allai gofalwyr ei
chyrraedd.

O ganlyniad, rwyf bellach yn byw yn yr hyn a elwir yn Setliad Cymreig yn yr
Ariannin. Rwyf wedi fy nisodli ac wedi fy dadleoli i’r eithaf. Serch hynny,
rwy’n ddiolchgar fy mod wedi goroesi gyda’m rhyddid, fy mywyd, a’m henw da
yn gymharol gyfan. Serch hynny, hoffwn fod wedi aros yng Nghymru, fel
Cymro, gyda safon a chynhaliaeth bywyd deg.

Mae fy ngwraig a minnau’n amharod i ganiatáu i’n merch hyd yn oed gamu ar
Ynysoedd Prydain o ystyried yr hyn a glywn sy’n digwydd yno. Yn 2024,
allforiais hyd yn oed fy nghi o Abertawe i’n heiddo yn y Caribî ar ôl i
unigolyn Afghanistan fod yng ngardd fy nheulu yng Nghymru, gan geisio ei
ddwyn.

Gofynnaf i’r Senedd gymryd y mater hwn o ddifrif, ac ystyried sefydlu
Ymchwiliad Cyhoeddus llawn, tryloyw ac annibynnol. Nid er budd fy nheulu yn
unig y mae hyn, ond er uniondeb hanes, cyfiawnder tir, a hawliau dynol yng
Nghymru.

Yn gywir,

*Sion Hywel Buckler*

*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*

Sirs/Ma'am,

I am writing to you regarding a significant historical injustice involving
my family, the Bucklers, and the destruction of Great House Farm (an
800-year-old site of monastic and Marconi history).

For example, in a 1974 press statement my grandmother said publically 'It's
my home'—that directly contradicts the 1987 Court of Appeal ruling that she
was 'silent' and accepted of BP license issued in 1974. My dad's appeal for
the BP vs Buckler 1987 case also got dismissed on grounds both BP Pension
Trust Ltd and BP Properties Ltd were effectively the same company. But in
the ruling he was appealing, the judge said that my nans replies to BP
Pensions Trust Ltd didn't count as BP Properties Ltd were the claimant, and
the two were seperate companies. So it was heads they win, tails we lose.
My dad was ripped from his hospital bed, jailed without charge and slapped
with a restraining order to keep him from occupying and defending our 800
year old farm from being bulldozed down. His ECHR request blocked before he
died in 1991 aged just 41.

I am requesting a *Petition for a Public Inquiry* into this case as a
matter of historical land theft and human rights violations in Wales.

I'm a military cyber and electronic warfare professional. We all have very
powerful AI technology at our disposal which can make light work out of all
of this. My family suffered an incredible injustice. It also appears to be
multi-generational warfare/ lawfare. Whereby we were treated as free labour
to upkeep the asset of the land and property until it was ripe to be cashed
in. I say this as every action against us seemed to be last minute.

There was allegedly press covering the 74 case and supporting my nan and
family and farm. There was a petition of 1700 people trying to defend us
and the farm from demolishment. CADW looked the other way when it should
have been a Grade II listed building. I could go on and on and on.

I'm not even sure the land registry recorded that our land, being
registered in 1982 by BP , was in dispute. I believe it was treated as if
it wasn't dispited. No court actually definitively determined that BP were
the landowners. It was just asserted.

Marconi stayed with our family at our farm when inventing radio. The
councillors and parish at Llandough won't even acknowledge this. I
understand Marconi was far right and so, like the radio statute at Cardiff
Bay has confirmed, he is being re-written out of history.  It stands to
reason that our family was caught in this political campaign of left vs
right. And for helping Marconi we found ourselves experiencing a century of
problems afterwards. Which didn't exist for the 3 centuries we were at our
farm before letting far right marconi stay with us. Marconi's mother was
also Jamerson of the Irish Whiskey company.

Do your own homework. Make your own enquiries. Draw your own conclusions.

 But please do not let history be rewritten here. My family are exploring
options for public speaking, story rights, and a documentary etc.

My grandfather was Ray Smith, of Dempsey and Makepeace. My aunty Shan
Cothi. My uncle started the band tigertailz.

This is an outrage and my family demands justice for being displaced and
stolen from, land and property, by the British Establishment/ BP -  with
little to no protections under law. And we're indigenous to the land,
Welsh, Welsh speaking, Welsh family. Resident in Cardiff / Vale and that
farm in Llandough for HUNDREDS OF YEARS.

There's tens of counts of fraud and concealment from what I can gather.
Which means the statute of limitation doesn't apply in this instance. I
know some are in favour of Wales decolonising and gaining independence. I
think there's no better example of BP vs Buckler 1987 and what has happened
to my family. Nobody else will bring this up because there's generational
trauma. Notwithstanding we, a welsh farming family, are speaking up and
against the British State and BP.

But I've proven myself. Leaving my military career with honours. Finishing
my 22 years Oath, bona fide, employed by the Vale of Glamorgan Council,
Welsh Government until 2024. I served in the wars in the middle east. I
don't know what is going on, on that island. But the farm injustice isn't
the only matter. My 36 day old son was abducted in 2013 and I've never seen
him since. I had a house stolen (40 Lombard Street, Barry). And in 2023 I
was left to sleep in a tent, while almost 100 afghans were secretly housed
next to our 11 home village. Where I had to be to care for my grandmother,
as no carers couldn't reach her. So I'm currently at the Welsh Settlement
in Argentina. So I'm as displaced and replaced as I can be to cater for the
insanity that's going on, on that island. And grateful I've managed to
survive it all with my liberty and life and reputation somewhat still
intact. But I would have actually liked to have remained in Wales as a
Welshman. And have some quality and standard of life. My wife and I are
reluctant for our daughter to even step foot on the British Isles with what
we're hearing that's going on there lately. And I even exported my dog from
Swansea to our place in the Caribbean in 2024 after an afghan was in my
family's garden in Wales, trying to steal him.

I look forward to your reply,

Regards,

Sion Hywel Buckler

texts.wb-d65895e7:
My dad was William Buckler in the legal case BP vs Buckler 1987. I have
concerns to raise about this whole ordeal.




This was not just an eviction — it’s a layered heritage injustice:

Displacement of an indigenous family (Bucklers) under imposed UK
nationality law.

Erasure of cultural memory (Roman burials, child graves, farming heritage).

Suppression of scientific history (Marconi’s stay, linked to the invention
of radio).

Ignored community objections (local petitions against demolition, which
themselves are part of “intangible cultural heritage”).

No memorialisation (the new development has no plaque, no marker
acknowledging the history).

II. Facts of the Case

1. Eviction and Demolition (1987):

The Buckler family were evicted from Great House Farm following litigation
brought by BP, supported by UK authorities.

The farm was demolished against the wishes of the local community.

My family maintained we always owned it. I believe the whole legal case was
a kangaroo court. And my family and the public were outsmarted. I believe
evidence exists proving my family actually did become equitable title
holders of the farm. And did own it. We were not squatters living rent free
for decades as was suggested in the court documents. Which is itself an
absurd claim.

2. Imposed Nationality:

At the time of eviction, Mrs. Buckler was a Welsh national with ancestral
ties to the land.

She did not freely consent to become a UK citizen; British citizenship was
imposed under the British Nationality Act 1948 and 1981.

This imposition extinguished her indigenous status in law, but not in fact.

The court proceedings never considered her as an indigenous Welsh person,
nor her ancestral rights to the land.


3. Cultural & Scientific Significance:

Great House Farm is historically significant as a residence of Guglielmo
Marconi during his pioneering experiments leading to the invention of radio.

The site also contained Roman burials and child graves, representing unique
archaeological heritage.

Despite this, no plaque or marker exists on the new development to
acknowledge Marconi’s presence or the heritage of the land.



4. Community Opposition:

Local residents petitioned against the demolition of the farm in 1987.

Objections raised by the community were disregarded.

The demolition destroyed not only a building, but also the intangible
cultural heritage of the community’s relationship with the farm and its
history.


CADW refused to list the building as protected.

---

III. Grounds for Complaint

Violation of the 1970 UNESCO Convention: The destruction and concealment of
cultural property (Roman burials, graves, artifacts) constitutes illicit
removal and suppression of heritage.

Violation of the 1972 World Heritage Convention: Sites of outstanding
universal value (Marconi’s residence, archaeological burials) were
demolished without recognition or protection.

Violation of Indigenous/Minority Rights: The Buckler family, as indigenous
Welsh nationals, were displaced through the imposition of foreign
nationality law and denied ancestral rights to their land.

Violation of Intangible Heritage (2003 Convention): The petitions and
objections of the community are part of cultural memory, yet no recognition
or preservation exists.


---

IV. Relief Requested

We respectfully request that UNESCO:

1. Acknowledge the destruction of Great House Farm as a cultural and
historical loss to Wales and humanity.


2. Investigate the circumstances of the eviction and demolition, including
the role of BP and the UK government.


3. Recommend that the site be marked with a plaque or memorial
acknowledging its historical significance (Marconi, Roman burials, Buckler
family).


4. Call upon the UK government to release any records concerning
archaeological excavations or heritage suppression at the site.


5. Recognise the Buckler family and local community as bearers of an
intangible cultural heritage unjustly erased.


My family were displaced and tresspasses in a rotten way. I am seeking any
justice for what I perceive to be hybrid human rights violations and war
crimes upon my family. And a most certain conspiracy against us.

I look forward to your reply,

Kind regards,

Sion Buckler
CEO
DATRO Security Group
DATRO Consortium Ltd

I have compiled a substantial historical archive, including newspaper reports, court references, family testimony, archaeological material, estate history, and public records relating to Great House Farm ("Ty Mawr"), a site associated with medieval, monastic, and Roman occupation.

The archive is currently being made into a website at:

bpvsbuckler.datro.xyz<http://bpvsbuckler.datro.xyz/>

The material raises serious unresolved questions regarding:

* The treatment of us Williams/Buckler family's longstanding occupation and asserted ownership claims. * The repeated use of possession proceedings without a full adjudication of superior title. * Missing or allegedly suppressed title documentation connected to Bute estate transfers and later transactions. * The demolition of an allegedly medieval structure during an active heritage controversy. * Whether the archaeological significance of the site was fully disclosed during planning and demolition processes. * The wider public interest and cultural significance of the site and its destruction.

It's looking to me like my family actually did obtain fee simple absolute and manorial title. Then it was stolen and attempts were made by the possessor of the stolen title, to make my family lessee's / tenants as we were when we were on the virtual freehold (999 year lease) aquired in 1667. Thereafter it appears to be a death of a thousand cuts of proceedural unfairness, audacity, fraud, court "mistakes" , purgery and more.

https://youtu.be/4GXmR7mAas0?feature=shared

Contemporaneous newspaper coverage from the 1970s and 1980s demonstrates that these concerns were publicly known at the time, including heritage objections, petitions, and public claims of ancestral ownership.

I am requesting:

  1.  Review and preservation consideration of all surviving records connected to Great House Farm.
  2.  Clarification as to whether any formal heritage review or investigation into the demolition process was ever completed.
  3.  Guidance regarding access to archival and planning materials relevant to the site.
  4.  Consideration of whether this matter warrants renewed historical or heritage examination.

I appreciate that some claims remain disputed or unproven, and I am not asking recipients to accept every allegation as established fact. However, I believe the totality of the historical material warrants serious review rather than dismissal.

I would be grateful for acknowledgement of receipt and guidance on the appropriate next steps.

Kind regards,



Sion Buckler Esq. (Ret'd Sergeant)

Manor of Llandough, Vale of Glamorgan

Sion Buckler

FORMAL NOTICE OF RECORD CHALLENGE, ASSERTION OF RIGHT, AND DEMAND FOR ENGAGEMENT



Dear Sir/Madam,



This Notice is issued for placement on official record and for reliance. It is not informal correspondence. I urge you not to resort to silence, deflection, or delay, as doing so following receipt of this notice constitutes knowing reliance upon, and maintenance of, records alleged to be materially defective through fraud, concealment, denial of due process, and systemic erasure. Please report any suspicious activity and discrepancies identified.



This Notice is issued in pursuit of narrative justice at this stage; formal judicial remedies are expressly reserved. It serves to document our family's side of the story before it is completely erased and history rewritten, ensuring awareness among custodians of land, heritage, heraldry, archaeology, and public records.



My elder brother, Rhys Buckler, and I are the sons of the late William Buckler (d. 1991), defendant in the landmark legal case BP Properties Ltd v Buckler (1987), and the grandchildren of the late Mary Williams, whose dispossession, marginalisation, and exclusion from judicial determination remain unresolved matters of record. Mary Williams was repeatedly and materially falsely addressed/mislabeled in legal and administrative records as “Mrs Buckler,” a misidentification that was never judicially tested and which directly affected the handling, scope, and outcome of proceedings. The Williams/Buckler family held claim to the land title, having acquired and occupied Great House Farm continuously since 1667, based on family records, historical evidence, and centuries of resistance to adverse claims.



I place on record that I am the first member of my family able to speak publicly and formally on these matters. Other close family members remain too traumatised and intimidated by the historical conduct of these proceedings—including violent eviction, demolition, and loss of livelihood—to engage, despite the continuing consequences of dispossession. That silence must not be misread as consent, acquiescence, or abandonment of right. There is a material distinction between free silence and silence produced by fear, trauma, and coercive experience.



The story, as we have pieced it together, reveals a multi-generational pattern of lawfare and siege: from Norman/English conquests in 1100 granting lordships over ancient Welsh Christian landscapes, through monastic (1215–1539) and Crown seizures (1539 onward), to industrial encroachments (e.g., 1876 Limeworks severance without consent) and modern corporate possession actions. This culminated in the 1988 demolition of an 800-year-old farmhouse amid police standoffs, leaving the family homeless and the site scarred, now buried under Church View Close. Archaeological vindication came too late—1994 excavations revealed over 1,000 Roman and medieval burials, confirming family warnings (e.g., the 1870 Roman soldier discovery under the living room floor, suppressed by authorities)—yet heritage records celebrate the site while omitting our dispossession.



The following assertions of right are now formally placed on record. They have never been lawfully adjudicated or extinguished:



1.      Rhys Buckler may be the rightful Manorial Lord of the Manor of Llandough, by right of primogeniture and continuous hereditary connection arising from our family’s occupation of Great House Farm from 1667 until our narrative, legal, and physical dispossession.

2.      I assert a claim to act as Squire of the Manor of Llandough, as executive representative and guardian of the Buckler–Williams estate and matriarchal lineage, with a mandate to pursue correction of record, restitution, and restorative remedies.



These are assertions of right, not settled declarations, placed on record pending proper adjudication—which has been historically obstructed through procedural narrowing, missing documents, and avoidance of full hearings.



In 1974, Mary Williams was twice prevented from presenting her case and obtaining a judicial determination of superior ownership, despite claims grounded in long occupation, intent, and possession. The court confined inquiry to animus possidendi (intention to possess) and excluded animus domini (intention to own), reclassifying her from putative owner to mere occupier and foreclosing title adjudication. BP sought possession only, not ownership rulings—a choice unexplained and significant. Proceedings were adjourned or quashed without resolution.



This occurred despite evidence of ownership intent, including:



*       Centuries-long occupation and resistance (e.g., failed 1938 auction due to local support; post-1945 rent disputes).

*       Roman-era remains and historical significance (e.g., Guglielmo Marconi's 1897 residence during radio experiments, with family aid erased from records).

*       Unformalized deals like the 1895–1905 Daniel Thomas quarrying permission for promised title, undermined by vanished deeds.



Judicial ownership examination would have engaged archaeological/heritage protections, incompatible with redevelopment—consequences avoided, raising credibility concerns.



Serious unresolved anomalies persist, indicating something is still not right with the record:



*       Licence correspondence dated 31 October 1974 surfacing only on 4 November, potentially interrupting proceedings to prevent hearings.

*       Claims of 1974 benevolent withdrawal under press scrutiny unsupported by verifiable coverage.

*       Land registration before Mary Williams’s 1983 death without title determination; disputes possibly lodged/suppressed by Land Registry.

*       Inconsistent treatment of BP entities across proceedings to family detriment.

*       Procedural barriers preventing effective defense (e.g., interrupted essential services post-licence; 1960–1987 court rulings dismissing ancestral title as "notion" without evidence).

*       Knowing bypass of archaeological constraints (e.g., 1978 trenches ignored; no contemporaneous 1970s/1990s press on discoveries amid development).

*       Missing key documents (e.g., 1667 conveyance, 1811–1835 Lambert Williams agreements proving status, 1982–84 library deeds vanishing).

*       Risks of further erasure: Heritage databases celebrate "Llandough Roman villa cemetery" while omitting our saga; modern residents unaware of the "battleground" site.



These anomalies suggest systemic theft, from colonial English subjugation (e.g., 1543–1770 orbit shifts) to corporate siege, during Wales' cultural/economic transitions. Authority derived through such means is illegitimate under natural justice, customary Welsh principles, and moral-legal frameworks. The record's distortion secures advantage, but passage of time does not validate it.



Preliminary assessment indicates cumulative benefits from redevelopment (absent title extinguishment) exceed £100 million, forming a basis for reparations—covering lost land, artifacts, livelihood, and trauma.



I require relevant public servants, custodians, and office-holders (including Land Registry, heraldry bodies, museums, archaeologists, MPs, historians, and councillors) to cease delay, engage substantively, review/correct/annotate records where defective, and prevent further rewriting of history. Justice delayed is denied, especially with verifiable evidence available.



This Notice:



*       Challenges the record's accuracy, completeness, and legitimacy.

*       Place assertions of title/standing on record pending adjudication.

*       Reserves all rights without prejudice.

*       Puts officials/beneficiaries on notice that silence/reliance may aggravate responsibility.



For the avoidance of doubt, His Majesty the King was notified yesterday.



This serves as an invitation to engage constructively before reliance becomes untenable.



Regards, Sion Buckler On behalf of the Buckler–Williams family [redacted], Wales. https://bpvsbuckler.datro.xyz/ <https://bpvsbuckler.datro.xyz/>



Postscript — Disability and Succession (Material Notice): The heir-apparent to the asserted Manorial Lordship is Rhys Buckler’s son, a young man with Down syndrome. Any obstruction, marginalisation, or differential treatment affecting his inheritance would engage the Equality Act 2010 and UK international obligations on disability rights. Disability cannot bar succession or recognition. This is recorded to prevent claims of ignorance.

proceedings—including violent eviction, demolition, and loss of
livelihood—to engage, despite the continuing consequences of dispossession.
That silence must not be misread as consent, acquiescence, or abandonment
of right. There is a material distinction between free silence and silence
produced by fear, trauma, and coercive experience.

The story, as we have pieced it together, reveals a multi-generational
pattern of lawfare and siege: from Norman/English conquests in 1100
granting lordships over ancient Welsh Christian landscapes, through
monastic (1215–1539) and Crown seizures (1539 onward), to industrial
encroachments (e.g., 1876 Limeworks severance without consent) and modern
corporate possession actions. This culminated in the 1988 demolition of an
800-year-old farmhouse amid police standoffs, leaving the family homeless
and the site scarred, now buried under Church View Close. Archaeological
vindication came too late—1994 excavations revealed over 1,000 Roman and
medieval burials, confirming family warnings (e.g., the 1870 Roman soldier
discovery under the living room floor, suppressed by authorities)—yet
heritage records celebrate the site while omitting our dispossession.

The following assertions of right are now formally placed on record. They
have never been lawfully adjudicated or extinguished:

   1. Rhys Buckler may be the rightful Manorial Lord of the Manor of
   Llandough, by right of primogeniture and continuous hereditary connection
   arising from our family’s occupation of Great House Farm from 1667 until
   our narrative, legal, and physical dispossession.
   2. I assert a claim to act as Squire of the Manor of Llandough, as
   executive representative and guardian of the Buckler–Williams estate and
   matriarchal lineage, with a mandate to pursue correction of record,
   restitution, and restorative remedies.

These are assertions of right, not settled declarations, placed on record
pending proper adjudication—which has been historically obstructed through
procedural narrowing, missing documents, and avoidance of full hearings.

In 1974, Mary Williams was twice prevented from presenting her case and
obtaining a judicial determination of superior ownership, despite claims
grounded in long occupation, intent, and possession. The court confined
inquiry to *animus possidendi* (intention to possess) and excluded *animus
domini* (intention to own), reclassifying her from putative owner to mere
occupier and foreclosing title adjudication. BP sought possession only, not
ownership rulings—a choice unexplained and significant. Proceedings were
adjourned or quashed without resolution.

This occurred despite evidence of ownership intent, including:

   - Centuries-long occupation and resistance (e.g., failed 1938 auction
   due to local support; post-1945 rent disputes).
   - Roman-era remains and historical significance (e.g., Guglielmo
   Marconi's 1897 residence during radio experiments, with family aid erased
   from records).
   - Unformalized deals like the 1895–1905 Daniel Thomas quarrying
   permission for promised title, undermined by vanished deeds.

Judicial ownership examination would have engaged archaeological/heritage
protections, incompatible with redevelopment—consequences avoided, raising
credibility concerns.

Serious unresolved anomalies persist, indicating something is still not
right with the record:

   - Licence correspondence dated 31 October 1974 surfacing only on 4
   November, potentially interrupting proceedings to prevent hearings.
   - Claims of 1974 benevolent withdrawal under press scrutiny unsupported
   by verifiable coverage.
   - Land registration before Mary Williams’s 1983 death without title
   determination; disputes possibly lodged/suppressed by Land Registry.
   - Inconsistent treatment of BP entities across proceedings to family
   detriment.
   - Procedural barriers preventing effective defense (e.g., interrupted
   essential services post-licence; 1960–1987 court rulings dismissing
   ancestral title as "notion" without evidence).
   - Knowing bypass of archaeological constraints (e.g., 1978 trenches
   ignored; no contemporaneous 1970s/1990s press on discoveries amid
   development).
   - Missing key documents (e.g., 1667 conveyance, 1811–1835 Lambert
   Williams agreements proving status, 1982–84 library deeds vanishing).
   - Risks of further erasure: Heritage databases celebrate "Llandough
   Roman villa cemetery" while omitting our saga; modern residents unaware of
   the "battleground" site.

These anomalies suggest systemic theft, from colonial English subjugation
(e.g., 1543–1770 orbit shifts) to corporate siege, during Wales'
cultural/economic transitions. Authority derived through such means is
illegitimate under natural justice, customary Welsh principles, and
moral-legal frameworks. The record's distortion secures advantage, but
passage of time does not validate it.

Preliminary assessment indicates cumulative benefits from redevelopment
(absent title extinguishment) exceed £100 million, forming a basis for
reparations—covering lost land, artifacts, livelihood, and trauma.

I require relevant public servants, custodians, and office-holders
(including Land Registry, heraldry bodies, museums, archaeologists, MPs,
historians, and councillors) to cease delay, engage substantively,
review/correct/annotate records where defective, and prevent further
rewriting of history. Justice delayed is denied, especially with verifiable
evidence available.

This Notice:

   - Challenges the record's accuracy, completeness, and legitimacy.
   - Place assertions of title/standing on record pending adjudication.
   - Reserves all rights without prejudice.
   - Puts officials/beneficiaries on notice that silence/reliance may
   aggravate responsibility.

For the avoidance of doubt, His Majesty the King was notified yesterday.

This serves as an invitation to engage constructively before reliance
becomes untenable.


Regards,


Sion Buckler

OBO the Buckler–Williams family

[redacted], Wales.

https://bpvsbuckler.datro.xyz

*Postscript — Disability and Succession (Material Notice):* The
heir-apparent to the asserted Manorial Lordship is Rhys Buckler’s son, a
young man with Down syndrome. Any obstruction, marginalisation, or
differential treatment affecting his inheritance would engage the Equality
Act 2010 and UK international obligations on disability rights. Disability
cannot bar succession or recognition. This is recorded to prevent claims of
ignorance.

*To whom it may concern,*

I am writing to formally report a long-standing and systemic case of what I
suspect may be dispossession, fraudulent misrepresentation, and
archaeological suppression concerning my family’s ancestral land, Great
House Farm (historically Tŷ Mawr/Cedfin), Llandough.

I am the descendant of the Williams/Buckler family, who held de facto
possession and indigenous tenure of this land from 1667 until our forced
displacement in 1988. I am currently the only member of my family who is
not too traumatized to speak of these events. My mother (Mary Williams
daughter in law), remains to this day too terrified to speak up about this
multi-generational "lawfare" campaign waged against us. Our family have not
seen justice or received reperations, nor have we sued or reopened this
case under limitations act clauses of fraud and consealment. Yet. But this
may not be just a grave injustice upon our family, but our nations
archeological history and indigenous people on our ancestral birthland. We
are Welsh Nationals, Welsh speaking, under Welsh flags. This is some
British Colonisation-grade trespass I'm seeing and it's tandamount to a
declaration of civil war on me, my family, community and people.

*The core of this report involves the following suspicions I have of
concealment and fraud (see attached for my timeline and notes):*

   1.

   *Archaeological Suppression:* In 1888, my family discovered a Roman
   soldier in full armor beneath the living room floorboards. This discovery
   provided "actual notice" of the site's national significance a century
   before its demolition. We allege this notice was systematically suppressed
   by corporate and state actors to allow for commercial development.
   2.

   *Fraudulent Misrepresentation in Planning:* During the 1987 planning
   process, the 13th-century fortified manor was described by developers as a
   "dilapidated utility building" or "ruined barn" to secure a demolition
   permit that would have otherwise been denied under heritage protection laws.
   3.

   *Legal Identity Falsification:* In 1974, BP Pension Trust issued a
   "unilateral license" intended to bypass our possessory title. This
   correspondence was falsely addressed to "Mrs. Buckler" to bind my
   grandmother to her deceased husband’s name and legal status, despite her
   public rejection of their claim. She used her maiden name Williams and her
   husband Bucklers' intent to accept license died with him. My nan also
   alledgedly didn't expressly deny the offer and so accepted through her
   silence. But she was near enough voiceless from screaming for decades that
   she will not do deals with any of them. That's a different kind of silence,
   if any. And to have responded to license to Mrs Buckler would have been
   identify fraud as she was Mrs Williams. And she did in fact reject BPs
   license offer and advanced, countless times, but publically. I believe
   these objections were suppressed too. There's allegedly news coverage from
   October 30th 1974 but I'm yet to find the evidence. But see attached a 1978
   article I unearthed. My nan clearly maintains her position "It's my home".

   4.

   You'll also see in landmark legal case BP Vs Buckler 1987 the judge says
   that she might have responded to BP, but to BP Pension Trust, but the
   claimant was BP Properties Ltd which were two separate companies. But in my
   dads appeal when he challenges that BP Pension Trust Ltd should have been
   the claimant the same judge dismissed his appeal citing both BP companies
   are effectively the same. This is clearly a case of heads BP won, Tails we
   lost.
   5.

   *Missing Evidence:* Critical title deeds and Bute Estate records from
   our families deal with Daniel Thomas, for title after quarrying completed,
   in exchange for our permission to quarry, also disappeared from the loft of
   our home and the Cardiff Library according to my families accounts,
   precisely when they were needed to support our ownership claim in the Court
   of Appeal. Regardless we should have still remained on grounds we'd been
   there since 1667, and failing that on grounds of adverse possession.
   6.

   It was evident lawfare to remove us, to get to the burials known about
   since 1888, BP profited from the land sale, the state and Crown have the
   exhevated artifacts and my displaced family are left traumatised, cheated
   and dead. My dad's appeal was dismissed to when it shouldn't have been and
   his ECHR request blocked, before dying abruptly at age just 41.

The confirmation in 1994 of a high-status Roman villa and over 1,000
burials on the exact site of our demolished home proves that the "official
narrative" used to evict us was predicated on the concealment of known
facts.

Under *Section 32 of the Limitation Act 1980*, the limitation period for
action does not begin until such fraud or concealment is discovered. As the
heir to this possessory title, I am seeking a formal investigation into the
institutional failures that permitted this dispossession and the
destruction of a national monument.

I have compiled my account and understanding of these events in timeline
order and I'm prepared to provide further testimony and evidence.

Given the extreme trauma my family has suffered, I request that all
correspondence be handled with the gravity this human rights violation
deserves.

Considering the lack of cooperation from my traumatised family. And
authorities who maybe complicit and implicated. And possible corruption of
records and fraud and consealment, I'm open to the fact my account and
understanding may not be perfect. But if even a single other person or
group looked into this too, even briefly, I'm sure you'll agree there's
merrit to the concerns I'm raising with all of this.

I look forward to your response regarding the appropriate next steps for
investigation and restitution.

I do ask for some small sense of urgency in that justice delayed is justice
denied. I understand this is ancient news for many, but my family still
feel a tremendous sense of disposition and disposition over all of this.
Bringing this all up means to re live it.

I will have been 3 or 4 at the time, but I still remember my toys in our
house, being bulldozed. And my mum handing us rocks to throw at them,
bulldozing down our home. As my dad was held without charges to prevent him
defending us and our home. I'd have to visit him in a hospital bed after
his heart attack and see him in a coffin shortly afterwards.

I'm 41 years old now. I'm a certified and experienced military commander
and leader. I left my military career with honours. I finished 22 years in
Oath in 2024, bond afide, my last 2 employed under the Welsh government.

I kindly request but also require of you, that this matter be layed to rest
correctly.

My family never surrendered. Never relinquished claim to that land. We
we're in honour in that we weren't there with force, stealth/ secrecy or
license. But BP and the British State did use force, stealth/ secrecy and
license.

All things considered I believe I find myself in honour here, and the
British Establishment in dishonour. This matter must be escalated. I'm duty
bound.


Regards,


Sion Buckler

Sirs/Ma'ams,

I am Sion Buckler, grandson of Mary Doreen Williams (née Williams), who 
lived at Great House Farm (Ty Mawr), Llandough, Vale of Glamorgan, Wales 
until her death in 1983. My family has maintained continuous occupation of 
the site since at least 1667 until 1988, with a key equitable arrangement 
via the Daniel Thomas quarry deal (c.1876 and/or 1895–1915) that we believe 
secured ownership of the house and garden separate from the surrounding 
leased farmland.

Despite this, the property was subject to possession actions by BP 
entities, culminating in demolition in 1988. The full title and ownership 
have never received a definitive court ruling on the equitable claim. But 
my grandmother maintained absolute title and that was undefeated all of her 
life. Until her conveniently timed death the fortnight BP registered her 
land into their names with the Land Registry in 1983. Regardless of the 
matter never being adjudicated. Ultimately Nan’s title got stolen; they 
purchased it. Which didn't change anything due to our firmly established 
standing and position in our town.

I am compiling a detailed chronological timeline with evidence on my 
website to support upcoming formal legal adjudication on who truly owns the 
site — including Roman villa and monastic remains beneath, which has never 
occurred. BP and the British State (synonymous in 1987) merely awarded 
themselves possession against a petition, after withholding and suppressing 
and destroying evidence, fraud, court "mistakes", procedural unfairness and 
abuse of power and what appears to be murder, against a disabled widow 
pensioner, last in her matriarchy. And her son, my terminally ill father. 
Who they tore from his hospital bed, detained without charge, restrained 
from returning home, while they demolished it with my pregnant mum and us 
children inside.

https://youtu.be/INfFOLndny0?feature=shared

Please forgive me in advance for my furious writing as I research what my 
family were subjected to, beyond what we even knew at the time.

Your expertise in Welsh history, quarrying, manorial estates, archaeology, 
or heritage would be invaluable. Any guidance, archive leads, or historical 
context you can provide would greatly assist in my research. I require 
support in this endeavour.
Support can also include a donation to the website 
https://bpvsbuckler.datro.xyz, which helps co-fund this work and bring the 
full story to light. It's also a branch on GitHub called bpvsbuckler on 
monorepo unclehowell/datro where developers can submit pull requests to 
propose changes.
This is my personal story — I was a child on the site during these events — 
and my family has been deeply affected, with my father and grandmother's 
deaths occurring at critical times while challenging the process. We 
believe the true historical and archaeological importance of the manor 
house site was downplayed and is concealed to this day, and we want the 
complete narrative told.

We were there since 1667 and owned it. Yet we got labelled squatters and 
"evicted" as "tenants" in 1988. ITV explicitly excluded that my mum was 
pregnant with us 3 toddlers. More so the presenter was like my second mum 
growing up: Nichola Hayward Thomas. Her son was my best friend. And she 
never mentioned to me she covered this story of us. And that footage was 
buried and only recently stealthily released on YouTube ITV archives after 
decades of suppression.

My Nan’s appeal in the news in 1974 was also excluded from the 1987 
hearing, where the judge ruled in favour of BP citing my Nan "conceived the 
notion" we owned our home. And that she accepted BP licence letters despite 
rejecting them in the suppressed 1974 press article. And in the 1975 
conveyance. I spoke to the Land Registry who have no clear answer how they 
did not see the land BP registered was being challenged by the 
owner/occupier. Who conveniently died the month, even the fortnight, BP did 
the conveyance to merge our home and garden land (since 1667) into their 
title of the surrounding farmland we leased for 3 centuries.

My family have never recovered and the last 38 years have brought us no 
justice or peace or remedy. I have enquired about a public enquiry from the 
Senedd. My family are still too terrified to speak up or out because of the 
conveniently timed deaths. My little sister, now 40, had nightmares after I 
called her to ask her about this. They're all like hostages under the 
occupation of terrorists after a literal act of terrorism, in that SAS 
(military), undercover as BP bailiffs, appear to have been used to 
dispossess us by UK State and BP (synonymous at the time) as part of their 
£7Billion deal.

I even suspect our case is not isolated and this could be a nationwide 
class action. Which resulted in many many indigenous, even manorial 
outright property and land owners like ourselves, being dispossessed by 
theft and abuse of power of Government and corporate greed individuals, to 
enrich themselves and their families' private estates. Leaving ours in 
ruins and faithless and in decades of living hell and generational trauma.

I left my military career with honours and finished my 22 years in Oath 
recently under the local council/Welsh Government. I'm now in Patagonia in 
a cabin to research all of this and reconnect with my Welsh language and 
culture where it's becoming increasingly prohibited under the British.
Before I flew here people in Wales were being arrested for preaching from 
the bible, flying the Welsh flag, commenting online about being replaced 
etc. 99% of British MP's refuse to even sign an EDM to condemn decapitating 
Christians. There's a Rosary Shrine with my family crest in a church in 
England. Where people can go and pray for the good estate of the Bucklers. 
Our coat of arms is in stained glass and our family Shield is on the tomb 
there. It's as if a demonic realm has plagued our lands and just keeps 
spreading and spreading. I've already now spent more of my adult life 
overseas than in Britain which is why I'm maybe still free, alive, bona 
fide and in full honours, despite being a practical counter officer in a 
civil war being waged on us.

I would welcome any advice or assistance in pursuing justice for this 
longstanding Welsh family, history and heritage claim.
I am also on my 13th year in exile. I only worked under the Welsh 
Government 2022/2024 while caring for my nan who died after taking the 
vaccine, notwithstanding 2 years of suffering what I believe was 
Guillain-Barré syndrome. I flew from New York back to Wales to care for her 
(after 8 years in exile before that), then flew back out after she died. 
Taking my dog abroad too after one of the 97 Afghans secretly housed 
outside of our 11 home village in Monknash, was in my garden trying to 
steal him. I was also expected to sleep in a tent by the Council when I 
flew back, despite the 97 Afghans being housed and given multiple times the 
amount of tax I paid those years. I was horrified I even had to care for my 
nan, but Monknash is so far from Barry where the healthcare workers all

The danger is real there, especially challenging the state narrative and 
reporting even half of what is going on. There's not even a plaque to 
commemorate Marconi staying with us while inventing radio. Not even on the 
park bench there. They removed the tree we planted on our land to 
commemorate our ownership, despite us still being owners. Nor is there a

Acting as any hostile illegal occupier would. MoD and MoJ all haven't

not realising I'd been collecting evidence for the last 20 years.

In Cardiff Bay the council have the statue of a radio with no naming of the

themselves that is. The whole thing is an outrage. It's also Wales' largest 
and most significant burial site. The injustice here is not just upon my 
brutally displaced family, but generations to come and our Welsh history 
and heritage. There's gaps in records, court "mistakes", procedural 
unfairness. Suppression. Fraud. It's decades and decades of lawfare. What 
and why are they so desperate to hide?
Marconi’s apprentice journalled that the success of their experiment was 
due to the zinc poles and copper and dragging it through lots of mud more 
so than the radio itself. Experiments were already underway before Marconi 
arrived to stay with our family in our house. My great grandad Mr Williams, 
took Marconi and equipment to Lavernock point by horse and cart. And a Mr 
Williams was documented in newspapers at the time as having been erecting 
the mast on the day of the experiment. Quartz and copper was discovered in 
the excavation under our farm. All this is documented and public record. 
Like the Roman soldier we discovered changing our floor from stone to 
timber in 1870/80.

amounting to bias or error in law, which may justify reopening under CPR
52.30 and Limitations Act Section 32.


---

Summary of the issue

In the 1987 case, the court ruled against my grandmother on the basis that
she did not formally reject an offer made by BP Properties Ltd, and treated
that as tacit acceptance. However, she had already explicitly rejected
prior licence attempts by BP Pension Trust Ltd, a related BP entity, before
BP Properties Ltd appeared as claimant.

The judge ruled that BP Properties Ltd was a distinct legal entity, and
therefore her prior rejection of BP Pension Trust Ltd’s offer was legally
irrelevant.

Later, in my father’s appeal, he argued that the wrong BP company had been
the claimant — that BP Pension Trust Ltd, not BP Properties Ltd, held the
relevant interest.
The appellate court dismissed his appeal, ruling that “BP companies are all
effectively one and the same” for the purposes of upholding the judgment.

This is a clear double standard:

When it benefited BP, the court treated the companies as separate.

When it benefited our family, they were treated as the same entity.


This contradictory reasoning — “heads BP wins, tails the Bucklers lose” —
represents either judicial bias, procedural irregularity, or corruption by
omission, and undermines the fairness of the original proceedings.


---

Grounds for reopening

Under CPR 52.30, a final judgment can be reopened if necessary to avoid
real injustice, in exceptional circumstances, where no alternative remedy
exists.
My argument is that:

The 1987 decision and subsequent appeal were tainted by inconsistent
application of corporate identity principles, creating real injustice.

The appeal court’s own language evidences bias and unequal treatment

Ltd [2019] UKSC 13 confirms that a judgment obtained through fraud or
concealment can be set aside even decades later — “fraud unravels all.”

Pursuant to s.32(1)(b):

> “Where any fact relevant to the plaintiff’s right of action has been
deliberately concealed by the defendant, the period of limitation shall not
begin to run until the plaintiff has discovered the concealment or could

Subject: Land Registry
From: Sion Buckler
Date: Thu, 29 Dec 2022 22:53 UTC
------------------------------------------------------------

Sirs,

In 2006 I took out a 109k GBP mortgage on the property (address 40 Lombard
Street, Barry).
The mortgage was with Manchester Building Society (MBS).
In 2011/12 I had arrears, which I paid. To the tune of 7K GBP.
But MBS also wanted 3.5k in fees for the admin/ reminder letters etc.
I said I would pay 2k GBP, but I felt 3.5k GBP was unreasonable.

Instead of being reasonable, MBS decided to abruptly return my arrears to
my bank and took possession of my home.
They did not say in their application to the courts that it was a human
rights issue (to take my home and make me homeless).
This I[m told was intentional in order the case get processed by the wrong
type of court e.g. a court that was favourable to them and not a court
where my inherent and inalienable rights as a British Subject are a factor
to be considered.
Furthermore MBS attempted to place a charge on my grandmothers property
and/or get her to remortgage with them, in order she pay the shortfall from
the auction. Fortunately the ombudsman defended my grandmother and made MBS
pay my grandmother 1k GBP in damaged for the alarm and distress they caused
her.

In recent years I did receive a final statement from MBS, which gives some
indication of the timeline. I also take this opportunity to add that a
contributing factor to why I was in arrears in the first place was because
I was not granted a payment holiday when required, which I'm sure was
actually a term of the mortgage, which MBS failed to honour.

Upon requesting a land registry record for the property today I discovered
I'm not even recorded as being on the property at all. Despite owning it
between 2006 and 2012. I also have a detailed credit report, which does not
show me having had that property either.

I believe serious fraud has occurred upon my person. And if this was the
case, I'm wondering what my options are to clear all this up so that I may
take out a  new mortgage and become a homeowner again.

Kind Regards,

Sion Buckler
